mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, writer_id, content, recomment_check) VALUES (#{postId}, #{writerId}, #{content}, 0)
INSERT INTO comment (post_id, writer_id, content, recomment_check) VALUES (#{postId}, #{writerId}, #{content}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id as commentId, c.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN c.recomment_check = 1 THEN SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.content,'::',1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS parentCommentId, u.nickname as writerNickname, c.content as content, c.write_date AS writeDate, c.like_num as likeNum, CASE WHEN c.recomment_check = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as recommendCheck, CASE WHEN c.delete_check = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as deleteCheck, CASE WHEN c.report = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as report FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.delete_check = 0 ORDER BY c.write_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND recomment_check = 0 AND delete_check = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT COALESCE(like_num, 0) FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
